project.title: Launch of Corporate Safety & Sustainability Awareness Campaign
project.objective: Design and roll out a cross-channel internal campaign to improve staff awareness of safety, security and sustainability practices across all sites.
deliverables: Internal launch event and activation plan
Content kit for digital channels and on-site signage
Quality and compliance checklist for campaign materials
Post-campaign evaluation report with improvement actions
constraints: All content must comply with legal and safety regulations
Campaign must be launch-ready within 21 days
Limited budget for physical materials and events
Messages must be understandable for non-specialist staff
Need alignment with existing corporate branding guidelines

risks.risk: Low employee engagement with the campaign content.
risks.mitigation: Use interactive formats, on-site activations and feedback loops; involve local champions in promotion.

risks.risk: Messages conflict with existing safety or security procedures.
risks.mitigation: Have security and safety officers review and sign off all materials before publication.

risks.risk: Tight timeline causes rushed, low-quality deliverables.
risks.mitigation: Prioritise critical channels, use a clear backlog and timebox reviews with defined owners.

risks.risk: Inconsistent messaging across digital, print and events.
risks.mitigation: Create a central messaging framework and style guide; route all assets through quality review.

themes.why_relevant: Core content of the campaign; must be accurate, practical and aligned with on-site procedures.
Need to balance digital, on-site and live events to reach different staff groups effectively.
Ensures materials meet legal, safety and brand standards before rollout.
Internal launch events and activations are key to driving awareness and engagement.
Post-campaign data and feedback will guide follow-up actions and next iterations.

backlog.task: Draft core safety, security and sustainability key messages for the campaign
definition_of_done: Key message document covers safety, security and sustainability pillars
Language reviewed for clarity and non-technical audiences
Stakeholder comments from security and safety officers incorporated
Approved by corporate communications representative

backlog.task: Define campaign strategy, target audiences and channel mix
definition_of_done: Audience segments and objectives documented
Preferred channels and frequency defined for each segment
High-level campaign calendar drafted
Strategy validated with corporate communications and operations

backlog.task: Plan and schedule internal launch events across main sites
definition_of_done: Event concepts and formats defined for at least three key sites
Dates, times and locations confirmed with site operations
Basic run-of-show and staffing needs documented
Risk assessment for events completed and logged

backlog.task: Create quality and compliance review checklist for campaign materials
definition_of_done: Checklist covers legal, safety, security and brand requirements
Review steps and responsible roles clearly defined
Checklist tested on at least one draft asset
Stakeholder feedback integrated and checklist versioned

backlog.task: Develop content kit for digital channels (intranet, email, social-style feeds)
definition_of_done: Set of short and long-form messages drafted using core messaging
Visual guidelines or templates aligned with brand
Content mapped to campaign calendar
Materials passed quality checklist and approved

backlog.task: Draft talking points and Q&A for spokespeople and event hosts
definition_of_done: Talking points aligned with key messages and safety procedures
Q&A covers likely employee questions and concerns
Reviewed by security and safety stakeholders
Final version shared with all designated hosts

backlog.task: Design on-site signage and quick-reference safety posters
definition_of_done: Poster concepts created for high-traffic areas
Content validated by security and safety officers
Designs checked against brand and quality checklist
Print-ready files stored in shared repository

backlog.task: Coordinate logistics and vendor needs for launch events
definition_of_done: Equipment, catering and materials requirements listed
Vendors or internal services booked and confirmed
Contingency plans for key risks documented
Logistics plan shared with site operations and security

backlog.task: Set up process for pre-launch quality review of all assets
definition_of_done: Review workflow and timelines documented
Owners and approvers assigned for each asset type
Tracking mechanism created for review status
Process communicated to campaign team

backlog.task: Define measurement framework and post-campaign evaluation approach
definition_of_done: KPIs and data sources for engagement and reach defined
Feedback channels for employees identified
Timeline for evaluation report agreed
Template for evaluation report created

backlog.task: Align security procedures and incident examples used in campaign
definition_of_done: Draft scenarios and examples collected from security management
Content checked for confidentiality and sensitivity
Examples integrated into messages and training moments
Final list validated by security management

backlog.task: Prepare internal FAQ and guidance for managers to brief their teams
definition_of_done: FAQ covers campaign purpose, timelines and expectations
Guidance note for managers drafted and reviewed
Language adapted for different operational contexts
Approved FAQ uploaded to intranet and shared with HR

artifacts.title: Campaign Strategy and Messaging Framework
artifacts.used_for: Central reference for objectives, audiences, key messages and tone across all channels.

artifacts.title: Safety, Security and Brand Quality Review Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Standardised pre-launch review of all campaign materials for compliance and quality.

artifacts.title: Campaign Channel and Event Calendar
artifacts.used_for: Planning and tracking timing of digital posts, on-site signage and internal events.

artifacts.title: Spokesperson Talking Points and Q&A Pack
artifacts.used_for: Equipping spokespeople and event hosts with consistent answers and narratives.

artifacts.title: Launch Event Run-of-Show and Logistics Plan
artifacts.used_for: Coordinating event flow, responsibilities and logistics across sites.

artifacts.title: Asset Review Tracker
artifacts.used_for: Tracking status, owners and approvals for all campaign assets against the checklist.

artifacts.title: Post-Campaign Evaluation Report Template
artifacts.used_for: Structuring analysis of engagement data, feedback and improvement actions.

artifacts.title: Manager Briefing Guide and Employee FAQ
artifacts.used_for: Helping managers brief teams and answer common questions about the campaign.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on campaign objectives, audiences and key messages before content creation.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff post in the channel sharing the draft objectives and asking for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final list of campaign objectives and primary audience segments.
Sign off on the core safety, security and sustainability key messages in A1.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define the campaign channel mix, calendar and event concepts.
threads_plan.trigger: Marketing consultant shares first draft of the channel plan and asks for input on events.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the final channel mix and minimum frequency for each audience segment.
Agree on the number, format and timing of internal launch events in A3 and A5.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Set up and validate the quality and compliance review process for all assets.
threads_plan.trigger: Quality services manager posts draft checklist and review workflow for comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final version of the quality review checklist in A2.
Agree on review SLAs and who must sign off each asset type tracked in A6.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on spokesperson materials, manager briefing guide and FAQs.
threads_plan.trigger: Spokesperson shares draft talking points, Q&A and manager guide for review.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the spokesperson talking points and Q&A pack in A4.
Approve the manager briefing guide and FAQ in A8 for distribution.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review launch readiness and define post-campaign measurement approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Quality services manager posts a pre-launch checklist update and asks for go/no-go and KPI confirmation.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm go/no-go for campaign launch based on checklist and asset status.
Agree on KPIs and timeline for the post-campaign evaluation using A7.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in post where each owner updates status on their top task and blockers.
Twice-weekly review of the Asset Review Tracker to clear approvals and flag risks.
Weekly planning message to confirm priorities and any changes to the campaign calendar.
Post-event debrief thread after each major internal event to capture quick learnings.
End-of-project retrospective discussion focused on what to improve for future campaigns.
